g.text: Negative Results: Multi-Graph and Periodic Lags
One global softmax collapsed toward the flow graph.
It could not express node- or time-specific graph value.
Strict comparison on the same 3,433 test windows
lag_48 overlaps with strong daily persistence;
lag_336 is brittle around holidays and gaps;
Node/head/layer graph routing and a learnable seasonal branch, instead of global graph scalars
Multi-graph avg MAE was 16.9569, also behind the single-graph gated model at 16.5350.
